profile.headline: Software Engineer III at SMC3
profile.summary: Detail-oriented Web Developer with experience in process engineering, project management, and leadership.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Created mockups for website redesigns utilizing AngularJS and Angular Material

positions.title: Packaging Manager
positions.description:
•  Led a team of 70 employees including four Supervisors
•  Managed packaging of EFG, brown and powdered sugar
•  Performed customer visits to address quality issues

positions.title: Bulk and Liquid Shipping Manager
positions.description:
•  Led a team of 12 Operators
•  Managed bulk loading of EFG and liquid sugar
•  Trained employees on process and quality procedures
•  Improved housekeeping in Bulk Station area by 25%
•  Implemented 5S

positions.title: Packaging Training Supervisor
positions.description:
•  Responsible for training of Packaging personnel
•  Worked with site Training Managers to develop a new hire training process
•  Developed Process Descriptions and SOPs
•  Coordinated maintenance activities

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
•  Improved reliability of centrifuges
•  Coordinated refinery maintenance

positions.title: Process Engineering Manager
positions.description:
•  Led four Process Engineers and a Process Control Technician
•  Sponsored Accident Incident Investigation Subcommittee
•  Led or participated in Standard Work, 6S, CTQ, VSM and FSM kaizen events
•  Experienced in Lean Manufacturing and concepts such as kanban, poke yoke, and JIT
•  Utilized statistical tools such as SPC, hypothesis testing, and DOE
•  Executed Engineering Change Notifications/Experimental Production Runs including equipment, process or product changes, raw material qualifications, and new product development
•  Responsible for Extrusion, Beaming, Weaving, Extrusion Coating, Printing and other Finishing processes
•  Investigated and addressed customer complaints
•  Provide technical support for the plant's capital/expense projects

positions.title: Finishing Department Manager
positions.description:
•  Member of plant leadership team 
•  Sponsored Ergonomics Subcommittee
•  Responsible for approximately 70 employees and processes including Extrusion Coating, Roll Sizing, Slitting, Packaging, and Cotton Bale Bag fabrication
•  Ensured the safety of employees through maintaining a safe working environment and promoting a strong safety culture
•  Successfully met production goals while producing a quality product

positions.title: Technical Engineer
positions.description:
•  Led denier reduction efforts saving $400k in extrusion costs
•  Utilized a stage gate process for managing the following projects:
   - Loom Installation, $256k. Increased weaving capacity by installing six looms and purchasing four Neuenhauser takeups
   - Air Bar Handling Device, $140k. Replaced and improved obsolete shaft handling equipment at coater line windup
   - Water Removal, $29k.  Redesigned nip tower and added a vacuum system in order to increase   production and improve yarn quality
•  Chaired Hazard Control Subcommittee for three years.  Developed and conducted What If Analysis training and performed What If Analyses on various equipment/processes.
•  Facilitated and/or led miscellaneous teams: skinner waste reduction, barrel heater shifting, and tight bands in 9137 fabric
•  Conducted SPC training for coater line operators
•  Participated in Customer Quality Audits and served as lead for the Industrial Fabrics Customer Quality Audit team
•  Tracked extruder screw and barrel wear and made recommendations for replacement.  Managed project for replacement of the screw and barrel on extrusion line
•  Coordinated, tracked, and analyzed data from resin qualifications and Experimental Production Runs

projects.title: Happy Choice
projects.description: This survey app provides users with an alternative decision making tool that optimizes total group satisfaction.  Voting points may be cast across several choices based on user preference thus increasing the chances of the user being in support of the winning choice.  Tools used in this project include: MongoDB, React.js, Express, and node mailer.

projects.title: Crystal Collector
projects.description: Win this game by selecting crystals to match the randomly generated number.  Random number and crystal values change each game.  This game was developed using html, css, bootstrap, JavaScript and JQuery.
